description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
While a cascade the eye went past by its whole box waits for its build, as after a cut, each frame builds every cascade at the most raised triangle budget, so a cut's view leaves the coarser cascades' light within frames.
The far cascade's band toward the light past its probes is weighed around the eye rather than in the cascade's grid, so a surface in it keeps its light as a walk moves the cascade a snap at once.
build/flicker.py reads a second recording of the same turn pair by pair against the first, blurs both pictures of a pair by a radius, and carries its map of a turn back into the first picture's camera, as the voxel game asked.
title: 3DEngine
